native_retrieval.title: Election Commission Of India: Ec Notification For Phase-1 Polls In The Northeast Out | Guwahati News - Times of India
native_retrieval.snippet: GUWAHATI: The Election Commission of India on Wednesday issued a gazette notification of the first phase of polling on April 19 in 14 Lok Sabha constituencies of Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura and Meghalaya, rolling out the start of the process of nomination filing by candidates. A s the last date of filing nominations is March 27 for the constituencies going to the polls in Phase-1, an updated electoral roll for conduct of election will be finalized on the last date of filing papers. For the rest of the phases, where last date of making nominations falls after April 1, the electoral roll will be prepared with respect to April 1, 2024 as the qualifying date. “However, as the last date of filing nominations for the 2nd phase of elections is April 4, all the advance applications w.r.t. 01.04.2024 and all claims for additions w.r.t previous qualifying date, received till 25th March, 2024, shall be disposed of before April 4 and electoral roll shall be updated and finalized on April 4, 2024 for use in polls,” the commission said.

native_retrieval.title: Election Commission issues notification for sixth phase of Lok Sabha polls – KRC TIMES
native_retrieval.snippet: ### Election Commission issues notification for sixth phase of Lok Sabha polls. The Election Commission of India (ECI) on Monday issued a notification for the fourth phase of Lok Sabha elections, which will take place on May 25 in 57 constituencies across six states and one Union Territory. This phase will witness polling for 57 Lok Sabha seats across six states and one Union Territory, including Bihar, Haryana, Jharkhand, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and New Delhi. The first phase of voting for the seven-phased Lok Sabha election was held on April 19 in 102 constituencies across 21 states and UTs with over 62 per cent voter turnout. The third phase of Lok Sabha elections will be held on May 7. The 2024 general elections will be held in India in seven phases, from April 19 to June 1, to elect the 543 members of the 18th Lok Sabha.
